column1: # Custom partition table for ESP32 with 4MB flash (used via PartitionScheme=custom).
# Stock OTA slots on 4MB are only 1.25MB each — too small for this sketch (~1.42MB).
#   - two OTA app slots of 1.75MB each (~320KB headroom over current bin)
# NOTE: changing the flash map requires a ONE-TIME USB re-flash of the whole
# image (bootloader + partitions + app). OTA from the previous 16MB layout
